proposals.before: On the gengxu day of the seventh month, 鍾岱 was transferred. In the eighth month, 十三恆恩: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: On the gengxu day of the seventh month, Zhongdai was transferred. On the thirteenth day of the eighth month, Heng'en: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.reason: Chinese 八月十三恆恩 means day 13 of the eighth month then the name Heng'en; English wrongly fused 十三恆恩 as one name and left other names untranslated.

proposals.before: 晏端書差. On the guihai day of the fourth month, 王茂蔭 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: Yan Duanshu was on assignment. On the guihai day of the fourth month, Wang Maoyin served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.reason: Chinese 差 marks detached assignment; English left 晏端書差 untranslated and left 王茂蔭 unromanized.

decisions.reason: s0061 reads 八月十三恆恩左副都御史: 十三 is the calendar day of the eighth month, then the name 恆恩. The prior idiomatic fuses 十三恆恩 as one personal name; the proposed split and romanizations match the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 八月十三恆恩左副都御史

decisions.reason: The same Chinese 八月十三恆恩 makes 十三 a day number and 恆恩 the person. The prior literal's fused name is wrong; the proposed wording correctly dates the appointment and names Heng'en.
s0042 opens 晏端書差, where 差 marks detached assignment, then 王茂蔭署左副都御史. Leaving 晏端書差 untranslated and 王茂蔭 unromanized is incomplete; the proposed English renders both accurately.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 晏端書差。四月癸亥王茂蔭署左副都御史

decisions.reason: Literal must also render 晏端書差 as Yan Duanshu on assignment and romanize 王茂蔭. The proposed replacement matches 晏端書差 and 王茂蔭署左副都御史 without adding or dropping content.
